brief: This filament rack is already built: four spool bays, each with a spool axle across it, and open bins on the pillar tops. Do not change the parts. Dress it for use: a 1 kg filament spool hanging on every axle, and a few small printing tools in the open top bins.

finish.summary: Dressed intact rack: 4 filament spools hanging on all axles, plus 2 small tool bins in top open compartments. Larger tools do not fit the divided bin geometry without intersecting walls, so only small div3 heaps could be staged.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
